title: Core map of where a unit booked from–to is v1
description: Carries a choice only: which unit. Where it is — its town, or its exact point when the company shows it — is the company's live record, read each time the page is; the map itself loads from OpenStreetMap only after the visitor asks for it (ADR-072, the map block of slice 5e).

unit.description: The unit (its id) the map is of — one the company shows its guests. Absent: the first unit on the company's form that has a place.
